# SILENCE-OBJECTS / silence-engine

Deterministic phi-timing scheduler. MIT. Cargo.lock pinned. rustc 1.98.1.
Do-not: 03_ee, raw streams, floating-point in the hot path, OS entropy, silence-ecosystem as default.
Cite: README.md, Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, src/lib.rs
Operating surface: SILENCE-OBJECTS + ev-silence-owner + silence-agents-org.
